name: Unity
oneLiner: UTY is XSY's delta-neutral synthetic dollar on Avalanche: USDC deposits hedged by long AVAX spot and short perps, with a 7-day redemption unbonding.
collateral: USDC deposits hedged via delta-neutral pairing of long AVAX spot positions with short perpetual futures; yield generated from perpetual contract funding rates; custody via Ceffu & Copper Clearloop
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDC to mint UTY at 1:1; XSY maintains peg by delta-neutral hedging with long AVAX spot and short perpetual futures positions; users redeem UTY back to USDC after a 7-day unbonding period

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: XSY describes UTY as a dollar claim minted from USDC whose managed backing uses long spot assets and offsetting short perpetual positions, with asynchronous redemption after the strategy unwinds. Peg defense therefore depends on maintained hedge neutrality and venue continuity, directly matching synthetic-delta-neutral.

oracleRisk.summary: UTY's documented Base mint path deposits USDC 1:1 and sweeps the backing to a custodian-managed strategy. XSY discloses exchange-level liquidation risk for managed short hedges, but public sources do not identify the strategy price-feed topology, freshness bounds, or fallback controls.

branchApplicability.rationale: YieldPoint documents one Base hub vault: users deposit USDC to mint UTY, backing is swept to a custodian, and redemption uses an asynchronous withdrawal queue. XSY describes protocol-managed strategy modules rather than borrower-owned debt positions. Therefore per-collateral oracle and liquidation branches do not apply; exchange liquidation of managed hedges remains strategy risk.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: UTY moves cross-chain via LayerZero's OFT standard in a hub-and-spoke design: Base is the hub holding the canonical UTY/yUTY ERC-7540 vault token, where a ShareOFTAdapter lockbox LOCKS tokens sent cross-chain (not burned); Avalanche and Katana are spoke chains where UTY is a mint/burn OFT against the locked hub balance. Each pathway is verified by at least 2 independent LayerZero DVNs (Base-Avalanche: LayerZero Labs + Google Cloud; Base-Katana: LayerZero Labs + Nethermind). On-chain confirmed: Base 0xBA515304... is the ERC4626/7540 vault; Avalanche 0xBA515304... (same CREATE2 address) is a LayerZero OFT spoke. Note: the registry's older Avalanche address 0xdbc5192a... is a separate legacy native-mint deployment, distinct from the live OFT spoke.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Pharos bridge-route re-verification; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20)

protocols.name: LayerZero (OFT Adapter lockbox on Base hub + mint/burn spoke OFTs)
protocols.note: Base ShareOFTAdapter locks the canonical UTY vault token; Avalanche/Katana spoke OFTs mint/burn. Threshold of >=2 independent DVNs per pathway (Base-Avalanche: LayerZero Labs + Google Cloud; Base-Katana: LayerZero Labs + Nethermind).

Canonical UTY hub on Base: the ShareOFTAdapter lockbox 0xc6fe7c5010621ab3ca5f4c018fad632f78b4d3f1 returns token() = this UTY and owner() = the XSY operator 0xa695bb4b9a86daf0581233031f273697135e3016 (verified on-chain 2026-07-20; the Avalanche OFT's peers(30184) points back to this adapter), so Base hosts the canonical token that OFT spokes lock against.

Controller verified on-chain 2026-07-20: endpoint() of the UTY token on katana returns the LayerZero endpoint 0x6f475642a6e85809b1c36fa62763669b1b48dd5b, so this deployment is the Unity OFT spoke and the OFT contract itself is the mint/burn authority for the representation (locks against the Base ShareOFTAdapter hub 0xc6fe7c5010621ab3ca5f4c018fad632f78b4d3f1).

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The current Base implementation has no deployed holder blacklist or freeze function. At Base block 48619333, Avalanche block 90284859, and Katana block 37285133, however, the same no-code EOA 0xa695bb4b9a86daf0581233031f273697135e3016 directly owned every tracked zero-delay UUPS proxy and could replace token logic with holder-control functionality. The Yes result is therefore an established upgrade-control capability, not a claim that a blacklist is presently deployed.

reserves.name: USDC deposits swept to custodial managed backing
reserves.issuerOrObligor: YieldPoint custodian and undisclosed strategy counterparties

reserveReview.rationale: Current YieldPoint flow documentation establishes that UTY is minted 1:1 against USDC on Base, the deposited USDC is immediately swept to a custodian wallet as off-chain managed backing, and redemption returns USDC after a seven-day asynchronous bonding period. Neither the current docs nor the public Accountable surface supports the historical 30% USDC, 35% long AVAX, and 35% short-perpetual weights, so those unsupported point-in-time percentages are replaced by one aggregate managed-backing envelope.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current YieldPoint issuance and redemption flows plus the designated Accountable reserve surface; managed-asset composition undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The USDC subscription and redemption asset is known, but current managed positions, retained USDC, strategy weights, venues, counterparties, hedge notionals, margin, and liquidation buffers remain undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: USDC deposits swept to custodial managed backing
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The reviewed sources establish the USDC mint and redemption envelope but not the current assets or positions held after the custodial sweep.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: YieldPoint documents custody via Ceffu and Copper Clearloop off-exchange settlement, which keeps strategy assets in segregated custody rather than on venue, but venue margin accounts, account terms, bankruptcy remoteness, and any reuse permissions are not disclosed.

mintAuthority.summary: The tracked UTY deployment mints collateralized vault shares from USDC on Base and uses LayerZero OFTs on Avalanche and Katana. All three UTY contracts are UUPS proxies owned without delay by the same EOA; Base's mutable maxTotalAssets cap is currently uint256 max and can be changed independently by any of three EOA MANAGER_ROLE members.

review.evidence: The prior record described legacy Avalanche token 0xdbc5192a..., which is not the address tracked in the deployment registry. Live RPC review of the tracked 0xba515304... address found three distinct UUPS implementations with the same EOA owner on Base, Avalanche, and Katana. Verified Base source established the collateralized mint path, mutable cap, enumerable manager set, and owner-only upgrade path; project docs establish Base as the vault hub and Avalanche/Katana as OFT spokes.
